content.label: Do not waste your money on this garbage app. First of all you have to say all your sentences and you can’t see what you are typing. It waits until you’re done before it puts it down, which is horrible because sometimes you think while you are looking at what you’re typing and it fully replaces the Apple dictation so you can’t switch between the two. And they claim to have access to all of your information. And it’s super user-friendly.
